rounds.prompt: The Mona Lisa ___ by Leonardo da Vinci.
rounds.note: A finished past action, with the painter as agent: was + past participle + by.

rounds.prompt: A new hospital ___ in our town at the moment.
rounds.note: 'At the moment' → present continuous passive: is being + past participle.
A general fact → present simple passive.
'Yet' → present perfect: Has … been repaired?

rounds.prompt: The thieves ___ by the police yesterday.
rounds.note: Plural subject, finished time → were + past participle.
After a modal: be + past participle.
Future passive: will be + past participle.
Finished past time → was + past participle.

rounds.prompt: My phone ___ (steal)! I can't find it anywhere.
rounds.note: A past action with a result now → has been + past participle.
In progress at a past moment → was being + past participle.

rounds.prompt: All the tickets ___ (sell) before the concert started.
rounds.note: Before another past event → had been + past participle.
A routine → present simple passive.
Modal + be + past participle.
Future passive: will be opened (or is going to be opened).
Subject + were + past participle + time.
Has been + past participle.
Is being + past participle.
Modal + be + past participle.
Have + object + past participle.
Subject + is said + to be.

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: The doors are locked at ten.
The film has been made in 2010.
rounds.answer: The film has been made in 2010.
rounds.note: A finished time (in 2010) needs the past simple: was made.

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: The car is washing by my dad.
rounds.answer: The car is washing by my dad.
rounds.note: The car doesn't wash anything: it is being washed by my dad.

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: It must to be done today.
rounds.answer: It must to be done today.
rounds.note: After must: be done, never to be.

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: They had repaired their roof by a builder.
rounds.answer: They had repaired their roof by a builder.
rounds.note: Causative: they had their roof repaired (by a builder).

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: He is believed to be abroad.
She is said to be clever.
They are thought to have left.
rounds.note: Is said + to be: he is said to be rich.

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: A new bridge is being built.
The prizes will be given tomorrow.
rounds.note: The past participle of write is written: was written.
Passive = be + past participle; the thing done comes first.
Continuous passive: being + past participle · perfect passive: been + past participle.
After a modal: be + past participle — never being, been or to be.
Causative: have/get + object + past participle · passive: be + past participle.
